Their Ultra Repair Hydrating Pillow Pads are so soothing and leave my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized. The product is lightweight and easy to use. Highly recommend

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First aid beauty ultra repair hydrating pillow pads were just OK. They weren't bad but I didn't see the ultra repairing or hydrating effect that it showed it offered. I was expecting it to be a little bit better. I did continue to use it to see if I got a better effect. It seemed to irritate my skin. I don't know if it was just the pad rubbing on my skin, but I don't think I've purchased in the future.

I received this product complimentary from First Aid Beauty. I love these gentle daily pads because they instantly soothed my combination skin. They've helped me a lot to boost the moisture I need at this time of year, when the cold weather leaves my skin very dehydrated and dull. They're so easy to use and are the perfect first step in my skincare routine. I use them on my face and neck before all my other skincare products, and I'm happy with the results. This brand never disappoints me; all their products are excellent.

I have super dry skin especially in these cold winter months. This product makes my skin comfortable and happy. It's hydrating but doesn't make my skin greasy or oily. I like the pads idea. It's great for traveling and keeping in my purse while I'm on the go to add a boost of hydration while out in the cold. The pads are nice and thick, pillowy indeed. I love this product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been loving this hydrating facial pads from first aid beauty. They are so pillowy and soft, and feel lovely on the skin. They hydrate beautifully and layer well with other steps in my skincare routine. They are great for on the go. The ceramides and colloidal oatmeal are such nourishing ingredients and I am glad to see them in this product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try a product from First Aid Beauty for the first time, but unfortunately the ultra repair hydrating pillow pads didn't work well for me. I have dry, acne-prone skin and I swiped a pad over my face before bed. The pads aren't as soft as I hoped, and the formula felt too lightweight, like I was just applying water on my face. It didn't feel like my face was any more hydrated than before. I also experienced some mild stinging/burning when applying the product. There is a light scent, but it's not irritating. The next morning, I noticed small, new pimples. I skipped the product for a few days and tried again to see if my skin reacts differently. Once again, I had a new pimple after using this product before going to bed. That said, I've had other family members try them, both younger (with acne) and older (sensitive skin, rosacea) and they both liked the pillow pads for hydration and soothing skin. This product might work well for others, just wasn't a good fit for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As a person who works out, I started to break out. Even though I would wash my face with face wash. But as soon as I started using this product, it didn't dry out my skin, my skin feels fresh after wiping my face with the pad. I'm now more confident with my clear skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using these Hydrating Pillow Pads from First Aid Beauty and I'm really impressed! They are super gentle yet effective, making my skin feel instantly hydrated and refreshed. The pads are soft, well-saturated, and don't irritate my sensitive skin at all. I love using them as a quick prep step before skincare or makeup, or even as a calming treatment when my skin feels dry or stressed. They absorb nicely without leaving a sticky residue, and my skin looks smoother and more plump after each use. Overall, these are a great addition to my skincare routine—especially for anyone dealing with dryness or sensitivity. I'll definitely be repurchasing!

I really like these moisturizing pads, especially in the winter or when my skin is feeling especially dry. I find it super soothing on the skin, with no really noticeable fragrance, and haven't experienced any irritation whatsoever. I like that this is in the form of a toner pad because I can layer it on before my normal moisturizer and other products without getting too greasy or heavy. I found this product especially perfect for prepping the skin before applying makeup because the product absorbs into the skin quickly and it doesn't cause pilling from greasy buildup.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] These hydrating pillow pads are good at hydrating any dry spots and the overall face. Although, they are only good for temporary relief as any real dryness comes back within hours. They do feel nice on the skin and do not cause any breakouts or reactions. Overall I did enjoy these, but for any chronic dryness a thicker cream might be better.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm very happy with these pads for my face. My skin is dry and sensitive, and they provide quick relief, drying almost instantly and giving me wonderful comfort. The ingredients hydrate and cleanse, helping my skin barrier. It's a product I would gladly pay for. I received it for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

avis.titre: Great moisture rescue for my combination skin!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this as a moisture rescue for my face. I have combination skin and I love that it hydrates my face without making me oily. My only con would be the sunscreen type smell, I'm not a fan of it. I also think it has helped get rid of some texture I had on my cheeks. Doesn't leave behind any residue, I'm able to layer my other skin care products without any problems. Packaging keeps the pads moist.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received these for free in exchange for my honest review. I really like how hydrating and soothing these first aid beauty pads are. I use them at various times; sometimes when i just want to freshen up my skin, and others when my skin feels irritated or dry. Unlike toner pads, they don't strip your skin or damage the moisture barrier. I like to let the pads sit on my face and soak in the moisture, and I like giving myself a gentle massage with the bumpy side. My only minor gripe might be that they can be hard to peel apart at times, but it's really not a big deal. These are nice to have on my vanity!

I received these First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Hydrating Pillow Pads for free in exchange for my honest review. I absolutely love these hydrating pads. They are super easy and convenient to use, you just gently swipe the pad over your face and your skin instantly feels soothed and moisturized. They have seriously helped my skin so much during the cold days of winter. Also, I love that they are unscented. I would definitely recommend this product to others and I will be purchasing more for myself in the future.
I love the concept of having cleansing pads that are medicated in a way and maybe I just got the wrong ones but they unfortunately dried my skin out too much.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm now obsessed with these First Aid Beauty hydrating pillow pads. I first used them after a cold weather trip where my skin felt so dry and in need of moisture. I used these and they immediately made a huge difference. My skin was hydrated again and had a glow to it. I now use these daily. It makes a big difference before applying makeup. My skin has never felt so moisturized!
I never leave reviews but these were awful. Minutes after using these my face started to burn and turn red. Definitely returning

This is a great product. Makes my skin tone more even and my skins feels very moisturized. Would recommend this for after you wash your face and before you moisturize. You definitely should try this product and add to your daily routine m.

I bought this product after one of my favorite skin care girls on tiktok loved it but after a few uses it really burned my skin. I didn't feel hydrated at all. After applying it, it would burn around my nose and even caused some peeling on the sides of my face. I have combo skin leaning dry on my tzone and have pretty tough skin so this caught me by surprise after those first few uses. Everyone's skin is different so use what works best for you!

avis.titre: Soothing Ultra Repair Hydrating Facial Pads
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the sleek and simple packaging of First Aid Beauty. There are 60 circular pads inside the container that are stacked and socked in the moisturizing colloidal oatmeal and ceramides that will hydrate and repair the skin. It's super easy to use, just take a pad and rub it in circular motion all over face and neck. It hydrates and removes any dirt on the skin, leaving skin clean and hydrated. I prefer using these every night after cleansing and drying my face. After toner if you use one and before moisturizer. It can also be used on its own for a quick moisture boost. Feels gentle in the skin and very soothing.

avis.titre: Literally a pillow in a jar!
avis.texte: As someone who deals with chronically dry skin in the winter months, these pillow pads are amazing! Each individual pad has plenty of product to coat your whole face and then some. They're great for soothing my skin after my skincare routine in the morning and night but also a quick and convenient way to give my skin some extra hydration when I'm on the go. I have definitely noticed an improvement in my skin after using these for a few weeks! *received this product in exchange for my honest review*

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I started using this as the first step in my skincare routine after cleansing and toning. I use the pad all over and it has a very soft silky feel. No residue is left behind and I have noticed my skin is feeling softer and smoother, and my moisture in my skin seems to last longer. I really really like these! They help calm down redness and have been a great addition to my skin prep.
After ONE USE it made my face feel like its burning and so dry!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the texture of the little pillow pads. They're so soft, and the little bumps on them catch the moisture from the product and spread onto my skin really easily. The pillow pads make my skin feel way bouncier and moisturized. It's not sticky at all, just bouncy and glossy. I appreciate the packaging too, since it's airtight I don't have to worry about the last few pads drying out before I get to them. I've noticed that my skin feels more hydrated, and the pads help cool off my skin after workouts which helps a lot with redness. Overall, super nice! I love using the First Aid Beauty ultra repair cream during winter and this is a great addition to my routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] These pads are super hydrating! They hold a good amount of serum in them. I've been using them daily as under eye patches and they've been helping with dry patches!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Really love the feel of these! They clean, hydrate, and give a really nice glow to my skin. They're super soft and pillowy which also feels great on the skin. Would recommend, especially in the drier months

These pillow pads pack an extremely hydrating milky toner in a pad format that I really enjoy. It makes them easy to apply and target exactly where you need extra hydration without a mess all over your hands or any potential wasted product. Popping them in the fridge provides an extra cooling effect that soothes dry and irritated skin. My skin drinks this formula up and feels noticeably hydrated after use and for a very long time after application.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using these pads for about two weeks now, and they've quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. As someone with combination skin that leans sensitive, I'm always cautious about adding exfoliating products, but these pads have been remarkably gentle yet effective. The texture of these pads is wonderfully soft—they really do feel like tiny pillows against your skin. They're generously saturated without being dripping wet. After using them, my skin feels noticeably smoother and more hydrated rather than stripped or tight. The colloidal oatmeal and hyaluronic acid in the formula seem to balance out the exfoliating acids perfectly, leaving my skin calm and plump. If you've been hesitant to try chemical exfoliation or have struggled with harsh toners in the past, these pillow pads are an excellent introduction. They're proof that effective exfoliation doesn't have to come with redness or irritation. The quality and gentleness make them worth it for anyone seeking smoother, brighter skin without the drama.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] These texturized pillow pads are versatile! Whether quickly hydrating my face or sticking the pad to extra dry skin as a spot treatment, these are a miracle! The colloidal oatmeal and ceramides work wonders. This pack comes with 60 pads and will last me quite awhile!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love these so much! They do what they're intended to do and they feel cooling as well! I've added them into my skin care routine, and I'm so glad that I did… I definitely recommend these! Especially if you have dry skin!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] These moisturizing pads are a super easy way to get some extra hydration into my skin. They aren't a replacement for my regular moisturizer but a nice addition.

Love these pads, they make my skin feel amazing and look radiant. They are in an easy open jar and have great scent. I have sensitive skin and it's hard to find products that don't irritate my skin, these don't irritate my skin at all.
